key: He said: O Noah! Lo! he is not of thy household; lo! he is of evil conduct, so ask not of Me that whereof thou hast no knowledge.
s: After the flood subsides, Noah pleads that his drowned son belonged to his household; al-Tabari, on 11:46, takes the son as truly his, yet not of the household promised rescue, since he opposed Noah’s religion, and reads the ‘evil conduct’ as that very plea.

evidence.words: وأولى القولين في ذلك بالصواب قول من قال: تأويل ذلك: إنه ليس من أهلك الذين وعدتك أن أنجيهم، لأنه كان لدينك مخالفًا، وبي كافرًا = وكان ابنه … والصواب من القراءة في ذلك عندنا ما عليه قراء الأمصار، وذلك رفع ﴿عَمَلٌ﴾ بالتنوين، ورفع ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ ، يعني: إن سؤالك إياي ما تسألنيه في أبنك … عملٌ غير صالح، لأنَّه مسألة منك إليّ أن لا أفعل ما قد تقدّم مني القول بأني أفعله
evidence.gloss: The more correct of the two sayings is that of those who said it means: he is not of your household whom I promised you to save, because he opposed your religion and disbelieved in Me; and he was his son … The correct reading for us is that of the reciters of the great cities, ʿamalun with nunation and ghayru in the nominative, meaning: your asking Me what you ask concerning your son … is an unrighteous deed, because it is a request from you that I not do what I had already said I would do.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, Hud 11:46, at 1518; first sentence of the ayah, 28 words). Plain sense faithful to day.js: 11:44 has the water subside and 11:45 has Noah plead that his son is of his household (the son’s drowning is 11:43); no four-word run from the key. In the packet on 11:46 al-Tabari reports two views (not his son at all, from al-Hasan, Mujahid and others; his son but not of the household promised rescue, from Ibn ʿAbbas, ʿIkrima, Saʿid ibn Jubayr, al-Dahhak) and says in his own voice that the second is sounder: not of the household he promised to save, because he opposed Noah’s religion and disbelieved, and truly his son, since God called him so. He then prefers the reading ʿamalun ghayru salihin and takes the unrighteous deed to be Noah’s request itself, asking God not to do what He had said He would do. The sentence carries exactly these two preferences, stated as his; ‘evil conduct’ is two words of the key in curly quotes. Evidence re-found in the packet. Entry-check ok.
